name: Common Reading Pipeline
description: A generic reading pipeline: recognizes requests to read stories, articles, reports, horoscopes and more aloud, and routes them to whichever installed provider skill can supply that content. Not tied to any single content type or source.

name: Finished Booting Skill
description: The Finished Booting skill provides notifications when OpenVoiceOS has fully started and all core services are ready

name: Colossal Cave Adventure
description: faithful port of the “Adventure” game to a OVOS Skill from the original 1977 FORTRAN code by Crowther and Woods.

name: Confucius Quotes
description: Quotes from Confucius

name: Date and Time
description: Get the time, date, day of the week
examples: What time is it in Paris?

name: Today In History
description: Provides historical events for today or any other calendar day using information pulled from Wikipedia.
examples: Tell me about events in history on December 12th

name: Dictation skill
description: continuously transcribes user speech to text file while enabled

name: Joan Fuster quotes
description: The Fuster quote of the day
examples: Tell me a quote from Joan Fuster.

name: GGWave Skill
description: Voice interface for ggwave plugin.

name: Hello World
description: Introductory Skill so that Skill Authors can see how an OVOS Skill is put together

name: Jokes
description: Brighten your day with dad humor. Laughter is not guaranteed, but eye rolls are likely.
examples: Do you know any Chuck Norris jokes?

name: Device IP Address
description: Network connection information
examples: What network are you connected to?

name: ISS Tracker
description: Track the location of the ISS
examples: how many persons on board of the space station

name: Local Media
description: Local Media File Browser For Open Voice OS

name: Movie Master
description: Find information about movies, actors, and production details. Easily find information about a movie with your voice.
examples: What are the highest rated movies out?

name: Naptime
description: Put the assistant to sleep when you don't want to be disturbed.

name: News Streams
description: News streams from around the globe.

name: Numbers
description: Facts about numbers

name: Parrot
description: Turn OpenVoiceOS into a echoing parrot! Make OVOS repeat whatever you want.

name: Assistant's Background
description: Learn history and personality of the assistant. Ask about the 'birth' and parentage of the voice assistant and get a taste of the community who is fostering this open source artificial intelligence.

name: Speedtest
description: runs an internet bandwidth test using speedtest.net

name: Volume Control
description: Control the volume of OVOS with verbal commands

name: Wallpaper Changer
description: Pictures from selected subreddits.

name: Weather
description: Get weather conditions, forecasts, expected precipitation and more! You can also ask for other cities around the world. Current conditions and weather forecasts come from OpenMeteo

name: WikiHow
description: How to do nearly everything.
examples: how do i get my dog to stop barking

name: Wikipedia
description: Query Wikipedia for answers to all your questions. Get just a summary, or ask for more to get in-depth information.

name: Wolfram Alpha
description: Use Wolfram Alpha for general knowledge questions.
examples: How many inches in a meter?

name: Wordnet Skill
description: Use Wordnet to answer dictionary-like questions.

name: skill-homeassistant
description: skill-homeassistant
examples: Change light bedside lamp to blue

name: skill-meal-plan
description: An OVOS voice skill for meal suggestions

name: skill-monster-scanner
description: An OVOS voice skill that scans for monsters under the bed
examples: Is the Boogeyman under the bed?
